waves 2 to 3 feet expected on Lake Moultrie.

* WHEN...Until 5 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds and rough waves on Lake Moultrie will create

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 6 to 10
feet with dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until noon PST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 9 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Moderate flooding of sea water is likely over some
vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the time
of high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike paths,
and harbor walkways. Moderate beach erosion is likely.
Isolated damage is unlikely but possible. There is an
increased risk for ocean drowning. Rip currents can pull
swimmers and surfers out to sea. Large breaking waves can
cause injury, wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize
small boats near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...An abnormally high tide of around 7.7
feet will peak just after 10 AM Friday morning.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to
elevated surf.

* WHERE...Santa Barbara County Southwestern Coast and Santa
Barbara County Southeastern Coast.

* WHEN...Through Saturday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore. Minor flooding of sea water is possible over some
vulnerable low- lying coastal areas, especially around the
time of the morning high tide Friday, including over beach
parking lots, bike paths, and harbor walkways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...An abnormally high tide of around 7.7
feet will peak around 1030 AM Friday morning.
